metadata.sampling_point: proximal antenna body origin; not distal arista or sensillum
metadata.frame_definition: neutral thorax axes expressed in head; follows articulated head rotation
metadata.velocity_method: mj_jac at body origin times native qvel; cm/s multiplied by 10

state_byte_encoding: Native little-endian float64 raw bytes encoded as hex; shape follows source arrays. These are the explicit nine arrays named in the plan script, not all MuJoCo state.
